chunks: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. You are truly on the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to hold fast to the revelation in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a command for the Prophet to hold fast to the Quran as the primary source of guidance, while also serving as a foundation for the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt who are considered the living embodiment of that revelation. The 'straight path' (Sirat al-Mustaqim) is viewed not merely as general correctness but as the specific, unbroken lineage of divine guidance culminating in the Imams. This reinforces the Shia belief in the continuity of revelation through both the text and the infallible interpreters.
